patterns: AI agents still dominate reach: EHuanglu's self-quote 'its over once swarm of AI agents start doing everything for us' blasted to 759K views / 5K bookmarks / 8K likes, quoting his own one-person-company clip from Wednesday. Agents > tools for raw distribution.

AI filmmaking got legitimized overnight: minchoi's 'You can't call this AI slop anymore' on a self-taught mom's 9-min fantasy film that won 4 NYIFF awards (90K views, 916 bookmarks, 168 reposts) plus his self-quote follow-up (12.3K). Proof + awards = save-worthy.
Before/after reveals crush creative lanes: AIWarper's 'Impressive..... very nice 🎸 Left = output / Right = input' hit 31K views and 302 bookmarks with almost no caption — pure visual contrast.

Model drop aggregation still prints: minchoi's Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash demos (13.1K), ChatGPT Images 2.6 GIFs (13.1K), and EHuanglu's DeepSeek v4.1 (11.7K) / GPT Image 2.6 vector (13.3K) all cleared ★ with short listicle hooks.

Seedance 2.5 stayed in the creative lane but under the 5K floor on the watchlist: techhalla's kung fu Seedance prompt (4.5K, 47 bookmarks) and azed_ai's cupcake disaster Seedance 2.5 (2.4K) show the method is there — bookmark ratio still strong even when views are mid.
Cost-of-AI-video narrative blew up outside the watchlist: anvisha's Voyager '5x cheaper Higgsfield' (1.35M) and the Seedance-at-half-price quote chain dominated outsider traffic.

drafts.draft_en:
You can't call this AI VFX slop anymore.

I cut a 90-second fantasy plate on Firefly + Seedance — same discipline as a real VFX vendor: locked camera, consistent character, graded refs.

This is what AI filmmaking looks like when you treat it like a shot, not a toy 👇
drafts.video_tip: 12-15s: open on a locked medium shot of the character, cut to a 2s before/after (raw gen → graded plate), then a 6s hero move with the camera slowly pushing in. End on the title card. No music ducking — keep one continuous score.

drafts.draft_en:
Left = AI output.
Right = what I fed it.

One reference plate, one Seedance 2.5 pass, zero visible cuts.

Steal the framing below 🎸
drafts.video_tip: 8s split screen, left output / right input, hard cut at 4s to full-screen output only. Keep both sides the same framing and lens so the transform is the only change.

drafts.draft_en:
I run AI VFX like a one-person vendor.

One agent breaks the brief. One generates the plates. One cleans the edges.

Here's a single House-of-David-style shot from slate to final 👇
drafts.video_tip: 10-12s vertical: left column ticks agent tasks (brief / plates / cleanup), right column builds the biblical-epic plate layer by layer. Freeze on the final frame for 1.5s with a single caption.

drafts.draft_en:
Gemini Omni dropped multi-turn motion transfer.

I tested it on a VFX handoff: take 1 actor performance → transfer to 3 costume variants without re-animating.

Consistency held. Workflow below.
drafts.video_tip: 10s grid: same motion, three costume variants side by side, then wipe to a close-up of the hands/face where consistency usually breaks. Label each variant with a 1-word tag.

drafts.draft_en:
Prompt share — kung fu rooftop, Seedance 2.5 🥋

Gritty parking deck at dusk, Manhattan haze, sodium lamps, cracked concrete.

Full camera + atmosphere block free below. Remix it.
drafts.video_tip: 6-8s: start locked wide on the rooftop, snap to a handheld close on the kick, then a slow orbit around the frozen pose. Drop the full prompt in the first reply, not the caption.
